01.title: Website Development
01.description: We design and build digital products from early concepts to scalable systems. Combining product strategy, UX and interface design, we help startups and established companies turn complex ideas into clear, usable experiences.

02.title: Web Design & Development
02.description: We create marketing websites that explain products clearly, strengthen brands and support business growth. From structure and content to responsive design and development, every website is built around a specific goal.

03.title: 3D Design & WebGL
03.description: Photorealistic 4K product renders and interactive 3D configurators right on your website, running smoothly at 60 frames per second with no third-party plugins.

04.title: AI Chatbots & Automation
04.description: Smart conversational assistants for WhatsApp and Telegram built on modern LLMs. Answers strictly based on your company's policies with no hallucinations (RAG), and automatic lead capture into your CRM 24/7.

05.title: Security & Quality Audit
05.description: In-depth source code analysis, vulnerability scanning against OWASP Top 10, server failure stress tests, and ready-to-apply security patches under a strict NDA.

06.title: SEO Optimization
06.description: Comprehensive on-site optimization to reach the top of Google and Yandex using white-hat methods. PageSpeed green zone 95+, clean semantics and Schema.org structured data.

aucahack.description: A digital campus for the university: frictionless course registration, predictive GPA calculation and a conflict-free schedule matrix.

conurat.description: Digitizing the construction cycle: from cost estimate drawings to end-to-end coordination of concrete deliveries and 14 active construction sites in the capital.

proquiz.description: An esports-style tournament engine: microsecond buzzer synchronization for 24 university teams at once with no network lag.

alfapark.description: A high-load ecosystem for a taxi fleet: automatic instant payouts to hundreds of drivers and round-the-clock fleet management.

p1.title: We follow the technologies of the future
p1.text: We study cutting-edge technologies and global trends to build modern digital products.

p2.text: We don't just follow what's new — we apply modern technology where it truly gives you an edge.
